title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Job Information Date Opened 11/19/2026 Job Type Full time City Chennai State/Province Tamil Nadu Country India Zip/Postal Code 600096 Industry Technology Job Description Site Reliability Engineer – Job Description Role purpose Improve availability, reliability and operational resilience of AWS/Azure-hosted platform services; own infrastructure-level troubleshooting and execution beyond L1 monitoring. Key responsibilities Provide L2 engineering for EC2, EBS, FSx, S3, ECS, Auto Scaling, RDS and agreed Azure compute/storage/infrastructure. Investigate degradation using Datadog, CloudWatch, AWS Health Dashboard and Azure telemetry; correlate application, container, host and cloud signals. Resolve/coordinate disk and storage capacity issues on Odoo EC2 servers and EBS volumes; validate filesystem growth, volume use and service impact. Troubleshoot ECS task-state changes, restart alerts, unhealthy services and deployment issues for MSSQL clusters and Commerce-api. Execute approved ECS service updates/forced deployments and EC2 Auto Scaling Group instance refreshes; validate instance health, capacity and application recovery. Review AWS account health events and determine infrastructure impact, mitigation and escalation requirements. Support network diagnosis, including replication path and port 1433 reachability over designated VPN; coordinate firewall/routing/VPN changes with authorized owners. Own infrastructure monitoring quality; review Datadog dashboards weekly, identify telemetry gaps and tune thresholds with approval. Contribute to AWS/Azure capacity management through storage growth, compute utilization, scaling and resource allocation analysis. Validate EC2 OS patch compliance for Windows, Linux and WordPress hosts; coordinate windows, pre/post checks and exception reporting. Review CSPM findings, validate cloud configuration context and coordinate remediation with designated security/cloud stakeholders. Support S3 archive validation and restore prerequisites; DBA retains database-level recovery ownership. Plan and participate in quarterly DR exercises for SQL Server FSx and RDS PaaS; validate infrastructure dependencies and recovery. Automate repetitive health checks, alert enrichment, evidence capture and routine remediation using PowerShell/Python/cloud-native automation, subject to review and approval. Maintain infrastructure runbooks, scripts, monitoring standards and known-error documentation; lead infrastructure RCA. Required skills and experience Hands-on AWS operations: EC2, EBS, FSx, S3, ECS, Auto Scaling, RDS and AWS Health. Working Azure infrastructure services and monitoring. ECS/container operations and deployment troubleshooting. Linux/Windows administration, storage, patching and service troubleshooting. Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor and observability. TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall, VPN and service-port validation. Reliability, incident response, capacity, resilience, DR and PowerShell/Python automation. KPIs / expected outcomes Cloud/platform incidents handled within agreed SLAs. Monitoring signal quality improved and avoidable alert noise reduced. Approved instance refreshes, ECS deployments and patch activities evidenced. Capacity and cloud health risks proactively identified. Automation with measurable effort/response-time reduction. DR findings and reliability actions closed. Authority and boundaries SRE owns infrastructure/platform engineering, not application code fixes or database-level tuning; database incidents are worked jointly with DBA. Production changes, failovers, security remediation and network-policy changes require approval. AI NOC is not assumed to replace SRE; automation requires human approval/rollback controls.

title: Network VAPT Engineer

Conduct network reconnaissance, enumeration, vulnerability scanning, exploitation, and validation. Identify vulnerabilities in servers, firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, and other network devices. Perform manual testing in addition to automated vulnerability scanning. Validate and demonstrate the impact of identified vulnerabilities. Prepare detailed VAPT reports with severity ratings, technical findings, business impact, and remediation recommendations. Work with clients and internal teams to understand network architecture and testing requirements. Conduct retesting after remediation to verify whether vulnerabilities have been addressed. Maintain proper documentation of testing activities and findings. Stay updated with emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security best practices. Required Technical Skills Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SSH, SMTP, SNMP, and other network protocols. Knowledge of network security concepts, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, routing, and switching. Hands-on experience with tools such as: Nmap Nessus OpenVAS Qualys Metasploit Wireshark Nuclei Netcat Working knowledge of Kali Linux or other security-focused Linux distributions. Understanding of common network vulnerabilities and attack techniques. Knowledge of CVSS and vulnerability severity classification. Ability to understand scan results and manually validate vulnerabilities. Good to Have Participation in CTF (Capture The Flag) competitions. title: Generative AI Developer - Hyd/Bang/Chennai
description: Dear candidate, Please find the JD for the AI Developer role below, let me know if you have any questions. Role Summary We are looking for an AI Developer to design, build, and run agentic AI systems: software agents that plan, call tools, use company data, and complete multi-step tasks with controlled human oversight. You will work with several model providers and model sizes, choosing and routing between them for quality, speed, cost, and data-handling needs, ensuring no single model or vendor becomes a point of failure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will write production code, build evaluation harnesses, and take agents from prototype to a monitored, secure, and supportable service. Key Responsibilities Agent design and build • Design and build agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, keep state, and complete multi-step business tasks. • Choose the right pattern for each problem (single agent, workflow with fixed steps, supervisor and worker agents, human-in-the-loop approval) and explain the trade-offs. • Write and maintain prompts, system instructions, tool definitions, and structured output schemas as versioned code. • Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and memory components, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and citation of sources. Multi-model strategy and orchestration • Work with several model families and providers (for example Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, and open-weight models such as Llama or Mistral) through hosted APIs, cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI), and self-hosted inference. • Build a model abstraction and routing layer that selects models by task type, quality, latency, cost, context length, and data-residency rules, with fallbacks when a provider fails or rate-limits. • Benchmark models on our own tasks and data, record the results, and re-evaluate when new models or versions are released. • Manage cost and latency through caching, batching, prompt compression, smaller models for simple steps, and token budgets. Tools and integrations • Connect agents to enterprise systems through REST and SOAP APIs, databases, message queues, files, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool standards. • Design tools with clear contracts, least-privilege access, input validation, idempotency, and safe handling of errors and retries. • Build integrations for document processing, search, email and messaging, workflow engines, and line-of-business applications such as claims, policy, and finance systems. Evaluation and quality • Build evaluation suites with golden datasets, automated checks, model-graded and human review, and regression tests that run on every change to prompts, tools, or models. • Measure task success, accuracy, groundedness, tool-call correctness, latency, and cost, and report them to stakeholders. • Run red-team and adversarial tests, including prompt injection, data leakage, and tool misuse. Safety, security, and governance • Apply guardrails: input and output filtering, permission checks before actions, approval steps for high-impact actions, and audit logs of every agent decision and tool call. • Protect personal and health data (PII and PHI) through masking, access control, encryption, retention rules, and region-appropriate hosting, in line with applicable regulations (for example data-privacy law and sector rules such as IRDAI). • Document model choices, known limitations, and risks, and support internal AI governance and model risk reviews. Operations and collaboration • Deploy agents through CI/CD pipelines to cloud or container platforms, with tracing, monitoring, alerting, usage and cost dashboards, and incident runbooks. • Provide L2/L3 support for agent incidents and carry out root-cause analysis, including bad outputs, tool failures, and model regressions. • Work with business owners, product managers, security, data, and integration teams to scope use cases, define success metrics, and plan rollout. • Review code and designs, mentor developers new to LLM engineering, and keep technical documentation and an internal catalog of agents, tools, and approved models. Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). • 4+ years of software development experience, including 1+ year building LLM-based applications that reached production. • Strong Python (and/or TypeScript or Java) with clean, tested, maintainable code. • Hands-on experience building agents with tool or function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step workflows, using a framework (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or a vendor agent SDK) or custom orchestration. • Practical experience with at least two model providers or families, and an understanding of their differences in context length, tool-use behavior, cost, latency, and data-handling terms. • Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector or hybrid search, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality tuning. • Experience designing evaluations for LLM systems (test sets, automated and human review, regression checks). • Strong API and integration skills (REST, JSON, OAuth2, webhooks) and SQL. • Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, containers (Docker), and at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). • Understanding of LLM security risks (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agent permissions) and of handling sensitive data. Preferred Qualifications • Experience running open-weight models (for example with vLLM, Ollama, or managed endpoints) and knowledge of quantization, serving, and GPU cost trade-offs. • Experience with fine-tuning or adapting models (LoRA, preference tuning, distillation) and judging when it is worth doing instead of prompting or RAG. • Experience with model gateways and routing tools (for example LiteLLM, or cloud-native gateways) and with observability tools for LLM tracing (for example Langfuse, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry-based tracing). • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent protocols, and building shared tool servers. • Experience with document AI: OCR, extraction from forms and PDFs, speech-to-text, and multilingual content. • Background in insurance, healthcare, or financial services, including claims, policy, or customer-service workflows. • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks and regulation (for example the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, or local data-protection and sector rules). • Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or cloud queues), workflow engines, and Kubernetes. • Relevant certifications (cloud, AI or ML, or security).
